selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does the palace stand for in the comparison?
questions.answer: It stands for this world.

questions.question: What does the floor of the palace mean?
questions.answer: It means the earth covered with many flowers.

questions.question: What do all things in the heavens and earth do for this King?
questions.answer: They praise and glorify Him.

questions.question: What do the amazing arts in the palace point to?
questions.answer: They point to Allah’s wonderful power in the world.

questions.question: What does the stove and kitchen stand for?
questions.answer: It stands for the earth, with fire inside it and the earth’s surface.

questions.question: Who does the master in the story stand for?
questions.answer: He stands for Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Who are the master’s students?
questions.answer: They are the awliya and pure scholars.

questions.question: Who are the guests at the banquet in this world?
questions.answer: They are jinn, human beings, and animals.

questions.question: Who is the first of the two groups in this world?
questions.answer: They are the believers.

questions.question: What is the better group called?
questions.answer: The people of belief.

questions.question: What part of the world is like the palace ceiling?
questions.answer: The heavens with shining stars.

questions.question: Why is the king described as great and powerful?
questions.answer: Because He made the heavens and the earth and rules over them.

questions.question: What do the palace apartments teach us about creation?
questions.answer: They show there are many ordered worlds.

questions.question: Why are summer fruits mentioned with the foods?
questions.answer: To show Allah’s mercy in the blessings we eat.

questions.question: What does the kitchen comparison teach about the earth?
questions.answer: It teaches that the earth has fire inside it and a surface outside.

questions.question: Who is the teacher for people in the real meaning of the story?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Who are invited guests in the guesthouse of the world?
questions.answer: Jinn, humans, and animals.

questions.question: Which group follows Satan and the lower self?
questions.answer: The people of unbelief and rebellion.

questions.question: Which group are the believers part of?
questions.answer: They are the good group that follows the Qur’an.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an explain about the universe?
questions.answer: It explains its signs and verses.

questions.question: When the story is explained, what is the palace said to be?
questions.answer: It is the world.

questions.question: What beautiful things are spread over the palace floor in the explanation?
questions.answer: Many kinds of flowers.

questions.question: How do creatures praise Allah?
questions.answer: Each one praises Him in its own way.

questions.question: What do the many palace sections stand for?
questions.answer: They stand for many different worlds.

title: Transition to Reality Application of the Palace to the World and Statement of the Two Parties
